prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Japanese basketball news article thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Generate exactly ONE finished opaque PNG, landscape 16:9, preferably 1792 x 1008 pixels (width at least 1000 pixels).

Create a polished hand-drawn sports editorial illustration with huge accurate Japanese typography. Approved visual language: deep near-black green #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B sweeping dry-brush streaks, warm ivory typography and monochrome ink drawing, one orange basketball as a small accent, bold brush grain and sparse ink splashes. Strong deliberate layout with very few elements. Do not make it photographic, 3D, or a photo collage.

Content source: fixed article title is「11/15 試合結果・当日のEFF」, dated 2026.11.15. It covers B.PREMIER and B.ONE results and that day's OFFICIAL EFF rankings, separated by league and registered position. No personal stats should appear. The graphic is an imagined basketball illustration, NOT a recreation of a particular game.

Subject: depict ONE real professional basketball player, Rawle Alkins (ラウリー・アルキンズ), in an energetic low driving step with a basketball controlled by his right hand. He was randomly selected from players named in the article, NOT chosen as the article's star. Do not print his name, number, team name, personal performance, score, or imply an award. Preserve his identity in hand-drawn ink: very muscular broad-shouldered athletic build; dark-skinned Black man; close-cropped black hair with subtle short texture and closely faded sides, NOT curls or dreadlocks; broad slightly elongated oval face and strong square jaw; prominent arched brows and large deep-set eyes; broad rounded nose; full lips; neatly trimmed moustache connected to a small dense goatee and short close beard along jaw. Short chin beard slightly fuller than cheeks. Facial highlights must keep eyes, nose, lips, and jaw readable. Strong facial resemblance and powerful physique, not a generic player. He wears a plain ivory basketball jersey and plain dark shorts, with a black compression sleeve on his LEFT arm; no logos, sponsors, lettering, numbers, or brand marks anywhere on clothing or ball.

Composition: text occupies the LEFT 56%; player occupies RIGHT 44%, captured in a dynamic low dribble drive rather than a static portrait or shooting stance. Use a three-quarter view so the face is large, clear, turned toward the left side with focused eyes. Torso leans forward, one knee bent entering the lower area, ball on the outer right under his RIGHT hand; left arm naturally bent protecting the drive, hand visible with natural anatomy. Keep the entire head, both hands, and entire ball comfortably inside the frame. Torso and legs may intentionally crop at lower frame, never at hands. Keep all words on calm clean dark space. A diagonal lime brush sweep behind the player creates motion but never covers text or face. No other people, no audience silhouettes, no scoreboard, no logos, no trophies, no decorative icons.

Render ONLY these exact text lines; each once, with no spelling substitutions:
「バスケまとめ」
「2026.11.15」
「試合結果」
「当日のEFF」
「リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3」
「B.PREMIER / B.ONE」
「イラスト（AI生成）」
「イメージ」

Text hierarchy:
Upper left small brand「バスケまとめ」and date「2026.11.15」.
Large primary headline「試合結果」in extremely bold ivory Japanese gothic.
Below it large「当日のEFF」in lime, with EFF in bold condensed Latin lettering.
Below that the clear readable scope qualifier「リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3」in ivory. Do not detach TOP3 from its scope or put it over the player.
Under it smaller plain text「B.PREMIER / B.ONE」.
Bottom left footer「イラスト（AI生成）」and beside it「イメージ」in small but readable ivory characters.
Use generous 4% outer safe margins. Do not crop or deform characters. High-contrast typography remains legible when thumbnail is reduced. No text from other sample articles. No fabricated scores, individual stats, player name, or player number.

This is an original illustration based on visual inspection of the official Tokyo Sunrockers profile for Rawle Alkins: https://www.sunrockers.jp/lp/rawle-alkins/ . The official photos are appearance references only; do not paste or reproduce the photograph. The intended black/lime ink design is based on the user-approved B-culver-black-lime-v3.png style; do not carry over its player or its old date or scores.

- Match the official face: broad oval face, strong jaw, large calm deep-set eyes, broad rounded nose and full lips, neatly trimmed moustache and small fuller goatee at the chin, short sparse close cheek/jaw beard. Keep the facial structure of the actual Rawle Alkins rather than a generic basketball player. Preserve focused action expression and face angle but relax the exaggerated raised/wrinkled brows.
- Reduce/reposition the head locally only as needed to leave at least about 30 pixels clear dark background above the hair. No head clipping. Keep natural neck connection and realistic proportions.
Do not paste the photograph, do not become photorealistic. Render facial features in the same confident hand-drawn ink crosshatching as the rest of the illustration.

qa_notes.source_qualifiers: 当日のEFFとリーグ別・ポジション別を併記。今季平均や全体トップ3とは表現しない。B.NEXTの試合や順位を示さない。公式登録ポジション・同率順位・算式差・公式配信値優先などの原稿の注記と矛盾する断定を加えていない。プレー場面は「イメージ」と表示。
qa_notes.likeness_or_no_named_person: 実在選手ラウリー・アルキンズ1人。公式プロフィール写真2枚を実見し、修正版の短髪、顔の特徴、ひげ、体格を比較。写真貼り付け・写真風表現なし。
